ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AGI Greenpac Limited has disclosed receiving an unsolicited "Adequate" ESG rating ('Crisil ESG 60') from Crisil ESG Ratings and Analytics. This independent assessment, based solely on public domain data and not initiated by the company, provides external validation of its baseline environmental, social, and governance practices. While "Adequate" implies room for improvement, this disclosure itself presents no immediate material negative impacts or red flags for investors.
